purpose: Turn an adjective into a noun naming its degree or quality.
keywords: い-adjective stem / な-adjective stem + さ.
Do you know the height of this mountain?
I like the quietness of this town.
formation: い-adjective stem / な-adjective stem + さ.
restrictions: This forms a quality noun; lexical naturalness still matters.
mistake: いい uses よさ rather than いさ.
